application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of a two-storey side extension and single storey rear extension to the house following demolition of existing single storey side extension
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Unnumbered Site Location Plan, PP/36/23/01,  PP/36/23/02, PP/36/23/03, PP/36/23/04, Reasonable Exception Statement, Heritage Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Design and Access Statement received 5 July 2023.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side elevation shall be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 metres above internal floor level. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition.
Condition : 5 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side elevation of the development hereby permitted.
